persona.who: A job never tested before: a property manager for 40 rental apartments. Builder who uses ChatGPT some weeks, Gmail and Google Sheets, computer and phone, her company is fine with AI.
persona.bio: Dana, 41, property manager for a small company that owns 40 rental apartments in three buildings. Tenants text and email her about repairs all day, and she books the plumber or the handyman and tells the tenant when they are coming. She does a walk through of each building every month with a checklist, sends rent reminders on the 1st, handles move ins and move outs with a key handover and an inspection, and answers the same questions about parking, trash days and laundry. She keeps a repair log and the rent roll in Google Sheets and works from Gmail. Repair requests and the monthly walk throughs take the most time. She uses ChatGPT some weeks for tricky emails. Her company is fine with AI, but no one has said anything about connecting her Gmail.
